status_reviews.segment_name: Phase II, Ganzhou South Branch (Huichang-Xunwu Segment)
status_reviews.researcher_notes: verdict: change (tentative), sharpened from batch_03's original tentative call with new corroborating evidence. batch_03 already flagged this row's 'shelved' status as questionable but unclear what to change it to. This pass adds: (1) the sohu.com 2021 provincial active-project roster names this exact segment (item 23) alongside its 3 sibling Ganzhou South branches, all part of one bundle whose EIA was approved 2017-12-28 (see Construction [ref] below) -- i.e. this branch was still an active, funded, environmentally-approved provincial priority as of 2017-2021, in tension with 'shelved'; (2) no source found anywhere in this batch or prior sibling batches actually documents WHY or WHEN this segment was shelved, or what the correct alternative status would be (construction? completed? genuinely shelved after 2021?). Not confident enough to propose a specific replacement status -- verdict remains 'change (tentative)/unclear' rather than a firm 'change', now with two independent-ish documents (quannan.gov.cn EIA filing + sohu.com provincial roster) supporting the tension rather than one. Recommend a human check against a post-2021 Ganzhou-area gas news search.
